findings.message: Entry param filtro (filter:listaTarefas) has no state in the definition. Added public state 'filtro' (TarefaFiltro | null, persisted, source entry.params.filtro); qryMinhasTarefas(filtro?, page?, append?) publishes it and sends it in the query input.

The definition has no '<command>.input' state for the form commands. Added public drafts cmdCriarTarefaDraft (with the generated chaveCriacao idempotency key, prefilled by entry params listaId and responsavelId), cmdSalvarEdicaoDraft and cmdSalvarChecklistDraft (filled from the opened task), cmdDevolverDraft (return reason), each with its setter (setCmdCriarTarefaDraft, setCmdSalvarEdicaoDraft, setCmdSalvarChecklistDraft, setCmdDevolverDraft) plus clearCmdCriarTarefaDraft.

The selection is fetched by qryTarefa, which takes the id or null; it publishes selectedTarefa, fetches the record into tarefa and fills the edit and checklist drafts. No separate selection method was added.

cmdCriarTarefa returns a TarefaDetalhe but the list rows (TarefaResumo) need computed indicators (venceHoje, atrasada, quantidadeSubtarefas, progressoChecklist) that the browser must not compute: the created task is NOT inserted in 'tarefas'; it becomes the opened task (tarefa/selectedTarefa) and the list shows it only after qryMinhasTarefas is called again.

Commands that return a task update the existing row of 'tarefas' by id (shared fields only) and remove it when the emRevisao/devolvidas filter no longer matches, but the indicators of the row (atrasada, venceHoje, progressoChecklist) are kept as loaded after a deadline or checklist change, and a reassignment may leave the task in criadasPorMim/atribuidasAMim lists it no longer belongs to; the contract gives no way to refresh them without reloading.
